title: Immutable Posting Intent Contract (System Root Schema)
description:
TIER-0 SYSTEM ROOT CONTRACT - MAXIMUM AUTHORITY LEVEL

post_intent.schema.json is the single canonical definition of:
'What does it mean to intend to post something?'

Every system component relies on this being:
- complete (no missing fields)
- deterministic (same input = same output)
- immutable (never edited after creation)
- forward-compatible (versioned evolution only)

This is not a validation convenience.
This is a legal, operational, and replay contract.

ABSOLUTE AUTHORITY BOUNDARY:
  intent_builder.py
        ↓
  post_intent.schema.json   ← YOU ARE HERE (ROOT CONTRACT)
        ↓
  posting_queue.py
  post_dispatcher.py
  posting_state_store.py
  monitoring/*
  learning/*

Nothing downstream is allowed to add meaning.

CORE RESPONSIBILITY (LOCK THIS):
Define the complete, immutable, replayable declaration of a posting action.

Once created:
- it is never edited
- never patched
- never 'fixed'
- Corrections require a new intent.

DESIGN PRINCIPLES (NON-NEGOTIABLE):
- Immutability first
- Explicit over inferred
- Platform-agnostic
- Forward-versioned
- Replay-safe

SCHEMA VERSIONING (MANDATORY):
Every intent MUST include 'schema_version': '1.0.0'
Rules: backward compatible only, no silent upgrades, consumers must declare supported versions.

schema_version.description: MANDATORY: Schema version. Rules: backward compatible only, no silent upgrades, consumers must declare supported versions. Every intent MUST include this field.

intent_id.description: REQUIRED: Globally unique identifier. UUIDv7 preferred. Never reused. Used as the primary join key across the system. CRITICAL: Immutable identity for replay and audit correlation.

created_at.description: REQUIRED: Unix timestamp (float) of intent creation moment. Never updated. Used for: replay ordering, audit correlation, SLA analysis. Creation moment only - no modifications allowed.

created_by.description: REQUIRED: Origin of intent creation. Enumerated values only. Used for: compliance, blame isolation, privilege audits. Determines accountability chain.

content.description: REQUIRED: Immutable content payload. All content must be addressable via URI, no inline binaries allowed. Checksum required for content integrity verification and replay safety.

content_id.description: REQUIRED: Unique identifier for this content piece. Must be stable and addressable. Used for content deduplication and retrieval.

content_type.description: REQUIRED: Primary content type classification. Determines platform-specific handling and validation rules.

checksum.description: REQUIRED: SHA-256 checksum of primary content. Required for content integrity verification and replay safety. Lowercase hexadecimal format only.

duration_seconds.description: OPTIONAL: Duration in seconds for video/audio content. Optional for static content. Maximum 24 hours (86400 seconds).

language.description: OPTIONAL: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'en-US'). Used for platform-specific language routing and content filtering.

caption.description: OPTIONAL: Text caption/description accompanying the content. Platform-specific formatting applied at posting time. Maximum 10,000 characters.

hashtags.description: OPTIONAL: List of hashtags (without # prefix). Platform formatting applied at posting time. Maximum 100 unique hashtags, alphanumeric and underscore only.

assets.description: OPTIONAL: Ordered list of content assets. Must be addressable via URI. Required for carousel content types. Maximum 50 assets.

asset_id.description: REQUIRED: Unique identifier for this asset. Must be stable and addressable.

uri.description: REQUIRED: Addressable URI for asset retrieval. Must be accessible by posting system. No inline binaries allowed.

checksum.description: REQUIRED: SHA-256 checksum of asset content. Lowercase hexadecimal format only. Used for integrity verification.

mime_type.description: OPTIONAL: MIME type of the asset (e.g., 'video/mp4', 'image/jpeg'). Used for platform-specific validation.

size_bytes.description: OPTIONAL: Asset size in bytes. Used for platform size limit validation and transfer planning.

targets.description: REQUIRED: Declarative targeting specification. Defines WHERE to post, not HOW. No account IDs - routing happens downstream. Platform-agnostic targeting only.

platforms.description: REQUIRED: Target platforms for posting. Dispatcher selects specific accounts. Minimum 1, maximum 20 unique platforms.

account_groups.description: OPTIONAL: Logical account groups (e.g., 'primary', 'backup', 'test'). Resolved by account registry. Lowercase alphanumeric, underscore, and hyphen only.

max_accounts.description: OPTIONAL: Maximum number of accounts to post to per platform. Hard limit for blast radius control. Minimum 1, maximum 1000.

geo_constraints.description: OPTIONAL: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes. Accounts outside these regions excluded from routing. Maximum 250 unique country codes.

constraints.description: REQUIRED: Hard boundaries for posting execution. Non-negotiable limits. If violated, intent expires rather than retries. These are explicit, not inferred.

earliest_post_time.description: OPTIONAL: Unix timestamp (float). Do not post before this time. Used for scheduled posting. Must be less than latest_post_time if both are specified. Cross-field validation enforced at application layer.

latest_post_time.description: OPTIONAL: Unix timestamp (float). Do not post after this time. Intent expires if not posted by deadline. Must be greater than earliest_post_time if both are specified. Cross-field validation enforced at application layer.

max_attempts.description: OPTIONAL: Maximum number of posting attempts per account. After this, mark as failed. Explicit value required - no defaults allowed. Minimum 1, maximum 100.

expiry_seconds.description: OPTIONAL: Time-to-live in seconds from created_at. Intent expires and cannot be executed after this. Maximum 1 year (31536000 seconds).

then.description: When both earliest_post_time and latest_post_time are present, earliest must be less than latest. This is enforced by application-layer validation.

visibility.description: REQUIRED: Declarative visibility specification. Logic may choose whether to post, but cannot change what visibility means. Platform-agnostic declaration only.

default.description: REQUIRED: Default visibility setting for all platforms unless overridden. Explicit value required - no defaults allowed.

allow_overrides.description: OPTIONAL: Whether platform-specific overrides are permitted. Explicit value required - no defaults allowed. If false, platform_overrides are ignored.

platform_overrides.description: OPTIONAL: Platform-specific visibility overrides. Only applied if allow_overrides is true. Keys must be valid platform names from targets.platforms.

risk_declaration.description: OPTIONAL: Risk classification and review requirements. Feeds risk_evaluator.py, rollout gating, and audit attribution. Lying here is detectable and actionable. All fields optional but recommended for compliance.

content_class.description: OPTIONAL: Classification of content origin and type. Used for risk assessment and platform policy enforcement. Explicit values: original (first-party content), repost (reposted content), trend (trending/viral content).

expected_risk.description: OPTIONAL: Declared risk level. Validated against actual risk score post-execution. Used for gating and review requirements. Explicit values: low (minimal risk), medium (moderate risk), high (significant risk).

requires_human_review.description: OPTIONAL: Whether human review is required before posting. Explicit value required - no defaults allowed. If true, posting is blocked until human approval.

metadata.description: OPTIONAL: Strictly non-operational metadata. Ignored by execution, routing, and retry logic. Pure annotation only. No operational meaning. Used for analytics, debugging, and human-readable context.

campaign_id.description: OPTIONAL: Campaign identifier for analytics grouping. Non-operational annotation only.

experiment_id.description: OPTIONAL: Experiment/A-B test identifier. Non-operational annotation only.

notes.description: OPTIONAL: Human-readable notes about this intent. Non-operational annotation only. Maximum 10,000 characters.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch, may include fractional seconds). Used for temporal ordering and scheduling.

uuid.description: UUID v4 or v7 format. Globally unique identifier. Never reused. Used as primary join key across system.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash in lowercase hexadecimal format. Used for content integrity verification and replay safety.

platform.description: Supported posting platforms. Platform-agnostic enumeration. Used in targets.platforms array.

visibility_level.description: Content visibility options. Platform-agnostic declaration. Used in visibility.default and visibility.platform_overrides.

risk_level.description: Risk classification levels. Used for gating and review requirements. Feeds risk_evaluator.py and rollout_controller.py.

content_class.description: Content origin classification. Used for risk assessment and platform policy enforcement. Explicit values: original (first-party), repost (reposted), trend (trending/viral).

content_type.description: Primary content type classification. Determines platform-specific handling and validation rules.

$comment:
TIER-0 SYSTEM ROOT CONTRACT - DO NOT MODIFY WITHOUT AUTHORIZATION

This file is written at the same authority level as posting_state_store.py.
If post_intent.schema.json is weak, everything downstream becomes probabilistic,
no matter how good your logic is.

WHY THIS FILE IS SYSTEM-CRITICAL:
- Retries depend on intent purity
- Audits depend on replay
- Learning depends on truth
- Platforms punish ambiguity

This file ensures: Intent is a fact, not a suggestion.

x-interaction-matrix.intent_builder.py: creates - builds intent from user/system input
x-interaction-matrix.post_dispatcher.py: reads - routes intent to platform handlers
x-interaction-matrix.posting_state_store.py: references - stores state linked to intent_id
x-interaction-matrix.learning/*: read-only - analyzes intent for ML models
x-interaction-matrix.rollout_controller.py: reads - gates rollout based on risk

x-invariants: intent identity is immutable (intent_id never changes)
targets are declarative only (no account IDs)
